consequences: New tasks receive stable global context and must load the relevant detailed system record before planning or editing.
Catalog validation rejects broken artifact references, unresolved repository paths and snapshot revision drift.
System-level progress must update the ledger/catalog while only universally required facts enter the compact snapshot.
context: The compact task snapshot was too small to preserve Project Sora's system plans, implementation progress, audits, artifacts and open work, while a single ever-growing Markdown file would create noise and concurrent edit conflicts.
decision: Maintain a mandatory compact snapshot, a detailed engineering ledger, and machine-readable system/artifact/milestone/open-item catalogs. Preserve effective engineering facts and evidence, not verbatim conversation transcripts.
title: Tiered project ledger instead of transcript context
